prompt: Close B2.3 frontend acceptance by restoring Storybook, adding isolated browser acceptance, stabilizing observed tests, localizing shared close controls, enforcing a measured bundle baseline, and recording reviewable evidence.
allowed_actions: Align Storybook development dependency versions and lockfile state
Add focused accessibility and test-stability coverage
Add isolated Playwright acceptance configuration, seed setup, and journey tests
Add a measured frontend bundle budget check
Update shared Dialog and Sheet accessible labels through the existing locale contract
Run focused and full verification and capture browser screenshots
Create B2.3 receipt, evidence, acceptance mapping, timeline, and advisory review
forbidden_actions: Implement deferred WorkGraph, Stage, Temporal, or Go backend capabilities
Change the canonical B2 information architecture
Hide failing checks or weaken behavioral assertions
Commit, merge, deploy, release, self-approve, or create a ship record
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run <focused B2.3 tests>
expected_evidence: Exact Storybook dependency alignment and successful static build
Focused accessibility and stability test results
Isolated desktop and narrow-desktop Playwright results and screenshots
Production bundle measurements against explicit budgets
Full UI and repository-facing verification results
Advisory merge-readiness review with residual risks and no self-approval
stop_conditions: Acceptance requires production data or the developer's existing database
A proposed stabilization would remove or materially weaken assertions
A browser failure reveals a B2 product regression that cannot be fixed within this slice
The work would require a deferred domain or orchestration capability
